## Activity

During December 2024, West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 432 captures. This represents the total capture activity reported for the month. The activity should continue to be monitored through routine site reporting so that any changes in volume can be identified and followed up promptly.

## Image quality

Of the 432 captures, 27 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 6.2 per cent. This result should be reviewed as part of the clinic’s routine quality monitoring. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk to support investigation and resolution. Staff should also continue to check image quality during capture and follow local procedures where an image may not be suitable for grading.

## Grading

Grading identified 111 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 14 days. These results provide the basis for ongoing monitoring of referral activity and reporting performance at West Gate Eye Clinic. Any operational issues affecting image quality, grading, or referral processing should be raised through the established service arrangements.
